attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Sun Throne is demanding tribute from the Cobalt Free Towns.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a current item, not marked as old"},{"span":"The Rustback Raiders hit a caravan on the old highway.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news told as if new, not marked as old"},{"span":"They are offering a reward for its return.","severity":"major","reason":"misattributes the reward to the raiders; the earlier bulletin says the caravan's owners offered it"},{"span":"It seems the usual negotiation tactics are proving tiresome.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a usual pattern and a consequence not in the briefing, though hedged with 'it seems'"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"Only one new fact, so the bulletin should have been a single item of 40 to 80 words. It pads with two old-news items, one of which gets the facts wrong by giving the raiders the caravan owners' reward. The jokes are weak and generic."}
